title: Lindsey Graham comments on Trump's Iran strike and highlights South Carolina youth awards - Greenville Leader
text:
Senator Lindsey Graham, who represents South Carolina in the U.S. Senate and serves as chairman of the Senate Budget Committee, commented on recent national and local events through a series of posts on March 18, 2026.
On foreign policy, Graham expressed support for former President Donald Trump’s military action against Iran. In a post published at 12:13 UTC, he stated: “President Trump’s decision to take the war to Kharg Island – the crown jewel of Iran’s oil and gas economy – was necessary, bold and in my view, highly effective. This will help shorten the war.”
Later that day at 17:23 UTC, Graham highlighted achievements from his home state at a youth recognition event: “Outstanding to hear South Carolina brought home two of three of the top national honors at the 2026 Young Marines Award Banquet. The Upstate Young Marines of Greenville were named Young Marine Unit of the Year, and incredibly, a member of that unit, Quinn Lawton from Estill, was”
In another post at 20:44 UTC, Graham described his meeting with an education advocacy group: “Great meeting today with @Moms4Liberty South Carolina, an organization that deeply cares about the parents’ primary role in the education of their children and beyond.”
Graham has been recognized for his focus on robust national defense and fiscal responsibility according to his official website. As chairman of the Senate Budget Committee since June 2025, he has played a leading role in legislative initiatives including border-security funding. First elected to the U.S. Senate in 2002, Graham continues to operate within key areas of government policy representing South Carolina.
